UnitStatement: SRC-CODE-APPS component apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs is the OpenPipeStress Tauri desktop backend exposing product-preview commands over local-only storage.
lib.rs declares the model_document_migration module for evaluating and recording model-document schema migrations.
lib.rs imports the library-import provenance crate (open_pipe_stress_library_import_document) as library_import_document.
lib.rs imports apply_operation and validate_operation from the open_pipe_stress_operation_applier crate.
lib.rs imports run_linear_static_preview and LinearStaticPreviewRequest from the open_pipe_stress_product_physics crate.
lib.rs imports the rule_check_runner crate for running rule-pack checks against solved models.
lib.rs imports the rule_pack_document crate for rule-pack validation and checksum computation.
lib.rs imports catalog_definitions and UnitDefinition from the open_pipe_stress_units crate.
lib.rs uses rusqlite (params, Connection, OptionalExtension) as the embedded SQLite storage engine.
PROJECT_STORE_FILE is the local project store filename 'openpipestress-projects.sqlite3'.
fixture_path resolves a product_preview fixture file across candidate relative paths and errors if none exists.
read_fixture loads a product_preview fixture path and parses it as JSON.
UnitCatalogResponse is the serialized unit-catalog response carrying schema_version, catalog_id, decision_basis, calculation_basis, storage_convention, entries, and a boundary.
UnitCatalogEntry serializes a single unit definition's id, symbol, dimension, canonical flag, transform_kind, factor/offset representations, provenance, and review_status.
UnitCatalogBoundary records that the unit catalog includes no protected content, no private project data, and claims no professional approval or code compliance.
unit_transform_kind returns 'identity' for a canonical unit, otherwise the schema value of the unit's transform_to_canonical kind.
unit_catalog_entry maps a UnitDefinition into a serializable UnitCatalogEntry.
desktop_unit_catalog builds the unit-catalog response from catalog_definitions with catalog_id 'unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display', decision_basis DEC-018, and calculation_basis si_canonical.
The unit catalog storage convention is 'entered_units_preserved' (units are stored as entered, not converted).
StorageCapability serializes the local storage capability: SQLite engine, bundled, fts5 availability, no network/daemon/telemetry, path and large-file policies, and migration evidence.
Local storage requires no network and no daemon, and has telemetry disabled.
LocalProjectSummary serializes a stored project's identity, storage mode, migration evidence, persisted-artifact counts and refs, and a unit round-trip status.
LocalProjectIndexEntry serializes a project index row: project_id, name, storage_mode, and created/updated unix timestamps.
LocalProjectEnvelope bundles a project summary with its model, editor_intents, proposal, selected_review_target, mechanics_result, analysis_run, hashes, and model-migration ledger.
SaveLocalProjectRequest is the deserialized save request; optional members default and model_document_migration carries open-time migration status for ledger recording (DEC-019).
SelectedReviewTarget deserializes a review target's target_type and id.
app_store_path returns the app-local data directory project store path, creating the directory if needed.
STORE_SCHEMA_TARGET_VERSION is 11 — the target SQLite store schema version.
STORE_MIGRATION_FRAMEWORK is 'versioned_sqlite_user_version_migration_ledger'.
StoreMigration pairs a schema version, a migration_id, and an apply function over a Connection.
StoreMigrationEvidence serializes migration framework, before/after schema versions, target version, applied-migration ids, pending count, and status.
store_migrations returns the ordered list of versioned SQLite store migrations (versions 1 through 11).
Store migration v1 creates the base local_projects and FTS tables.
Store migration v2 adds the editor_intents_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v3 adds the proposal_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v4 adds the selected_review_target_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v5 adds the mechanics_result_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v6 adds the analysis_run_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v7 adds the model_hash_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v8 adds the project_envelope_hash_json column to local_projects.
Store migration v9 adds an evidence-only model-document migration ledger column (DEC-019); the model-document schema version authority stays in-document.
Store migration v10 creates the local_rule_packs table; private rule packs stay in the local store and are never committed or transmitted (OPS-K-PRIV-1).
Store migration v11 creates the local_libraries table; only accepted PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY imports are written and private libraries are never committed or transmitted (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD section 13.5).
The local_rule_packs table is keyed by (project_id, rule_pack_id) and stores document_json with created/updated timestamps.
The local_libraries table is keyed by (project_id, library_kind, library_id) and stores document_json with created/updated timestamps.
migrate_v1_base_tables creates local_projects and a local_project_fts FTS5 virtual table over project_id, project_name, and model_text.
store_user_version reads the SQLite PRAGMA user_version as the store schema version.
open_project_store opens a SQLite connection at a path and applies store migrations, returning the connection and migration evidence.
Each store migration step is idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS / column probes) so legacy stores reconcile cleanly from version 0 without data loss.
apply_store_migrations enables foreign_keys and WAL journal mode, then applies each migration whose version exceeds the current user_version, advancing user_version and recording evidence.
ensure_column adds a column via ALTER TABLE only when PRAGMA table_info shows it is absent (idempotent column probe).
sqlite_compile_options reads the SQLite PRAGMA compile_options list.
fts5_available probes FTS5 support by creating and dropping a temporary fts5 table.
now_unix_seconds returns the current time as Unix epoch seconds.
project_name_from_model reads project.name from the model, defaulting to 'Untitled OpenPipeStress Project'.
project_id_from_model reads project.id from the model, defaulting to 'project:untitled-local'.
upsert_project inserts or updates a project row with all JSON-serialized envelope members and refreshes the FTS index in a single transaction.
The FTS search_text concatenates model, editor_intents, proposal, selected_review_target, and analysis_run JSON for full-text indexing.
StoredProjectRecord holds a loaded project's id, name, and deserialized envelope members.
load_project loads a project by id, or the most recently updated project when no id is given, deserializing each JSON envelope member.
list_projects returns project index entries ordered by most recent update then project_id.
normalized_editor_intents coerces editor_intents to a JSON array, defaulting to an empty array.
normalized_proposal coerces a proposal to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_selected_review_target coerces a selected review target to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_mechanics_result coerces a mechanics result to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_analysis_run coerces an analysis run to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_model_hash coerces a model hash to a JSON object, else Null.
normalized_project_envelope_hash coerces a project-envelope hash to a JSON object, else Null.
proposal_count returns 1 when a proposal is an object, else 0.
editor_intent_count returns the number of editor-intent array entries.
selected_review_target_count returns 1 when a selected review target is an object, else 0.
object_count returns 1 when a value is an object, else 0.
persisted_analysis_run_ref resolves a run_id from analysis_run, falling back to mechanics_result, else 'not_persisted'.
persisted_model_hash_ref returns the model-hash value string, else 'not_persisted'.
persisted_project_envelope_hash_ref returns the envelope-hash value string, else 'not_persisted'.
selected_review_target_ref formats a selected review target as 'target_type: id', else 'not_selected'.
unit_round_trip_summary scans the model's units, materials, sections, pipe segments, and load cases to build a unit-reference signature and a preserved-or-missing status.
unit_round_trip status is 'unit_metadata_preserved_in_local_project_envelope' only when unit refs exist with no missing refs; otherwise review is required.
collect_quantity_unit records a quantity's unit reference, or marks the reference missing when a value has no unit.
value_id reads an object's id field, defaulting to 'unidentified'.
project_summary assembles a LocalProjectSummary from project identity, model, database path, migration evidence, and persisted-artifact counts and refs.
Tauri command get_unit_catalog returns the desktop unit catalog response.

Tauri command render_calculation_report deterministically renders hash-bound HTML with three-point protected-content gates and a non-hash-bound derived print view naming the canonical hash (DEC-021 / A7).
Tauri command load_preview_model reads the bundled invented_preview_model.json fixture.
Tauri command load_design_knowledge reads the bundled invented_design_knowledge.json fixture.
solve_preview_mechanics deserializes a PreviewModel and runs run_linear_static_preview with no extra materials.
resolve_solve_model_payload returns the supplied model, or the bundled invented_preview_model.json fixture when none is supplied.
Tauri command run_preview_mechanics solves the supplied or bundled preview model synchronously.
SOLVE_JOB_CANCELLATION_SCOPE is 'cooperative_checkpoints_not_preemptive' — solve-job cancellation is cooperative, not preemptive.
SolveJobStartReceipt carries the job_id, backend cancellation token, state, and cancellation scope of a started solve job.
SolveJobStatusReport reports a solve job's state, cancellation request/status, scope, optional result, and optional error message.
SolveJobCancellationReceipt reports whether a cancellation was accepted, its status, the job state, scope, and that no cancellation-success is claimed.
SolveJobRecord holds an in-flight solve job's cancellation token, state, cancellation flags, result, and error message.
SolveJobTable is the in-memory registry of solve jobs keyed by job_id with a monotonic next_job_number.
SolveJobRegistry wraps the solve-job table in an Arc<Mutex<>> for Tauri-managed shared state.
lock_solve_jobs acquires the solve-job table lock, mapping a poisoned lock to an error.
start_solve_job allocates a new job number, builds a job_id and cancellation token, and inserts a queued SolveJobRecord.
execute_solve_job marks a job running (or cancelled if cancellation was requested before start), solves, and publishes the outcome.
publish_solve_outcome records a solve job's completed/failed result, or discards the result when cancellation was requested before publication.
solve_job_status returns the status report for a known solve job, erroring for an unknown job_id.
cancel_solve_job validates the cancellation token, rejects requests after terminal states, and otherwise records a cooperative cancellation request without claiming success.
Tauri command start_preview_mechanics_job starts a background solve job on a spawned thread and returns the start receipt.
Tauri command poll_preview_mechanics_job returns the status of a solve job by id.
Tauri command cancel_preview_mechanics_job requests cancellation of a solve job using its id and cancellation token.
build_sample_agent_proposal builds a review-only agent proposal from computed mechanics that does not mutate accepted model state and makes no compliance/approval claim.
The sample agent proposal asserts the model is invented and not a project basis, and that no protected criteria, allowables, or owner-standard values are available.
Tauri command sample_agent_proposal returns a sample agent proposal, computing preview mechanics first when no result is supplied.
Tauri command validate_model_operation validates a structured model operation against a model and optional claimed hash without mutating it.
Tauri command apply_model_operation applies a structured operation to a model and returns the outcome.
Tauri command get_local_storage_capability opens the project store and reports the storage capability and migration evidence.
Storage path policy is app-local user data path with no repository-default writes.
Large-file policy references external files by path/hash metadata and does not silently copy large files.
refuse_model_document formats a refusal message reporting status and source/target schema versions for a refused model document.
hash_value_string reads a hash object's value string, defaulting to 'not_reported'.

prepare_model_document_for_persist resolves the model document, migration status, and ledger to persist for create/save (DEC-019): refusing unsupported/newer documents, migrating older ones, and appending a ledger record for a migrated document.
Persisting refuses model documents whose status is newer_than_supported, unsupported_schema, or failed.
When the open-time status was 'migrated', persisting records a migration ledger entry even though the incoming document is already current in memory.
A migration ledger record is appended with pre- and post-migration model hashes and a Unix timestamp when a migrated document is persisted (DEC-019).
Tauri command create_local_project normalizes envelope members, prepares the model document for persist, upserts the project, and returns the project envelope.
Tauri command open_local_project loads a project, migrates the restored document in memory when a chain applies, and refuses newer/unsupported documents for editing (DEC-019).
Tauri command list_local_projects returns the local project index.
Tauri command save_local_project normalizes envelope members from the request, prepares the model document for persist, upserts the project, and returns the envelope.

Rule packs are separate user-controlled documents, not members of the preview model document; they persist only in the local SQLite store (local_rule_packs, store v10) and are never committed, transmitted, or exported by default (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD section 17.3).

Rule-pack validation and checksum computation route through core/rules; statuses are software findings only and never professional, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance claims (OPS-K-AUTH-1).
LocalRulePackIndexEntry serializes a rule-pack index row: project id, rule_pack id/name/version, lifecycle status, privacy class, storage mode, and timestamps.
LocalRulePackEnvelope bundles a stored rule pack with its validation result and a message.
LocalRulePackDeleteReceipt reports whether a rule pack was deleted and a message.
rule_pack_document_string reads a JSON-pointer string from a rule-pack document, defaulting to 'TBD'.
rule_pack_id_from_document requires a non-empty metadata.rule_pack_id and errors otherwise.
rule_pack_validation_value validates a rule-pack document (optionally for public export) and returns the validation result as JSON.
StoredRulePackRow holds a loaded rule-pack document with created/updated timestamps.
upsert_rule_pack inserts or updates a rule-pack document keyed by (project_id, rule_pack_id), preserving created_at on conflict.
load_rule_pack loads a stored rule-pack document by project_id and rule_pack_id.
list_rule_packs lists rule packs, optionally scoped to a project, surfacing metadata fields from each document.
delete_rule_pack deletes a rule-pack row and returns whether any row was affected.
Tauri command validate_rule_pack validates a rule-pack document, defaulting public_export_requested to false.

Tauri command run_rule_checks runs a rule pack's checks against a solved model and returns per-check outcomes; a pack with blocking validation findings is reported RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE without running checks (completion plan C4).

run_rule_checks resolves private_library_value inputs from the local private-library store at run time; a reference that cannot be resolved is omitted so the input stays unsupplied and the check blocks — never a silent pass.
run_rule_checks_core is store-free rule-check orchestration; the Tauri command resolves library references into library_value_bindings before calling it, and tests target it directly.
A rule-check run with blocking rule-pack validation findings returns aggregate_status RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with empty checks and a professional-boundary notice.

Solver values for solver_result inputs come from an authored in-pack solver_result_ref (canonical) and legacy caller-supplied {input_id, result_id} selectors (fallback); an authored reference governs its input alone and the caller selector for that input is dropped.
A rule-check run sets current status MechanicsSolved only when the envelope's status.mechanics is MECHANICS_SOLVED, otherwise ModelIncomplete.
resolve_rule_check_project_id resolves the library-lookup project id from an explicit id, else model /project/id, else the solved envelope /model_ref.

resolve_library_value_bindings resolves each private_library_value input carrying a library_value_ref to a binding by reading the referenced slot from the local private-library store; unresolvable references are omitted so the input blocks, never a silent pass.
resolve_library_value_bindings_with_connection is the store-bound core of library-value resolution, separated so tests can drive it with an in-memory connection.

extract_library_slot_value reads {value, unit} from a library record's value slot for material, section, or component kinds; material values carry value.unit_ref.ref_id while section/component values carry a plain value.unit string.
Material library_value_ref targets material_records[material_id].allowables[allowable_id], the user_rule_allowable / private_reference rule-check source.
Section library_value_ref targets section_records[section_id].dimensions[dimension_id] or properties[property_id].
Component library_value_ref targets component_records[component_id].fields[field_id].

extract_library_slot_value returns None (so the binding is omitted and the check blocks) when the kind is unknown or the record/slot/value is absent or non-numeric; the private value is read at run time and never embedded in the rule pack (IP boundary).
find_library_slot_value looks up a record by record_id_key in records_member, scans each (slot_array, slot_id_key) in order, and returns the first matching slot's value object, or None.
parse_quantity_magnitude parses a library quantity magnitude that may be a JSON number or a numeric string, returning None when absent or non-numeric.
parse_library_value_bindings parses caller-resolved {input_id, value, unit, library_kind, library_id, record_id, slot_id} library values for private_library_value inputs.
solver_result_row_value reads {value, unit} from a solved envelope results row whose id matches result_id, returning None when no row matches or the row lacks a numeric value or string unit.

resolve_solver_result_bindings resolves caller-supplied {input_id, result_id} selectors against the solved envelope results, omitting a selector with no matching row so the input blocks; an authored solver_result_ref supersedes this legacy path.

resolve_authored_solver_result_bindings resolves each solver_result input carrying an authored solver_result_ref to a binding and returns the set of input ids carrying an authored reference (resolvable or not).

An authored solver_result_ref governs its input alone: the caller cannot override or rescue it at run time, and an unresolvable reference yields no binding so the input blocks at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
parse_supplied_value_bindings parses caller-supplied {ref_id, value, unit, dimension} user values for user_supplied_rule_value inputs and value-slot limits.
Tauri command compute_rule_pack_document_checksum computes a rule-pack document checksum via the rule_pack_document crate.
Tauri command save_local_rule_pack stores a rule-pack document to the local SQLite store only; drafts with findings remain saveable and are never transmitted or committed.
Tauri command open_local_rule_pack loads a rule-pack document from the local SQLite store with its validation result.
Tauri command list_local_rule_packs lists rule packs, optionally scoped to a project.
Tauri command delete_local_rule_pack deletes a rule-pack document from the local SQLite store and reports the outcome.

The library-import validation seam exposes the runtime library-import provenance crate (the DEL-03-07 port) so the GUI import wizard can validate a parsed material/section/component import payload before storing it; validation is a pure function with no persistence or file parsing.

Library-import validation statuses are software findings only; the command makes no legal license, redistribution, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance determination (OPS-K-AUTH-1, IP boundary), and unsupported library_kind / intended_visibility tokens are rejected, never guessed.

LIBRARY_IMPORT_BOUNDARY_NOTICE states library-import validation reports software findings only and makes no legal license, redistribution, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance determination.
library_import_validation_value validates an import payload via validate_library_import_tokens, flags blocking/quarantine findings, and returns a JSON validation envelope with the boundary notice.
Tauri command validate_library_import validates an import payload for a given library_kind and intended_visibility.

Imported material/section/component libraries persist in the local SQLite store only (local_libraries, store v11) and are never committed, transmitted, or exported by default (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD section 13.5, section 17.3).
The private-library store is private-by-default: save re-validates every document with intended_visibility 'private' and only stores an accepted (PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY) import.

Suspected-protected (QUARANTINE) and otherwise-blocked (REJECTED) library imports are refused — their findings are returned but nothing is written — a conservative IP-boundary posture differing from the rule-pack store.
LocalLibraryIndexEntry serializes a library index row: project id, library kind/id/name, privacy class, storage mode, and timestamps.
LocalLibraryEnvelope bundles a stored library document with its validation result and a message.
LocalLibrarySaveResult reports whether a library import was stored, with optional timestamps, the document, validation, and a message.
LocalLibraryDeleteReceipt reports whether a library was deleted and a message.
StoredLibraryRow holds a loaded library document with created/updated timestamps.
library_metadata_key maps library_kind material/section/component to its metadata key, rejecting unsupported kinds.
library_id_from_document requires a non-empty <kind>_library.library_id and errors otherwise.
library_document_string reads a library document metadata field string, defaulting to 'TBD'.
library_import_is_storable returns the import-validation envelope's accepted flag — only an accepted PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY import may be written; REJECTED/QUARANTINE imports are refused.
upsert_library inserts or updates a library document keyed by (project_id, library_kind, library_id), preserving created_at on conflict.
load_library loads a stored library document by project_id, library_kind, and library_id.
list_libraries lists libraries, optionally scoped to a project, surfacing name and privacy_class from each document.
delete_library deletes a library row scoped by project, kind, and id and returns whether any row was affected.
Tauri command save_local_library re-validates an import at the private boundary and stores it only when accepted; a blocked/quarantine import returns its validation without persisting.
Tauri command open_local_library loads a library document from the local SQLite store with a re-run private-visibility validation.
Tauri command list_local_libraries lists libraries, optionally scoped to a project.
Tauri command delete_local_library deletes a library document from the local SQLite store and reports the outcome.
run() builds the Tauri application, manages the SolveJobRegistry, and registers the invoke_handler with all desktop commands.

The Tauri invoke_handler registers commands including load_preview_model, run_preview_mechanics, the solve-job commands, project/rule-pack/library storage commands, run_rule_checks, and render_calculation_report.
lib.rs contains a #[cfg(test)] tests module exercising the unit catalog, report rendering, solve jobs, storage migrations, model-document migration, and rule-check/library wiring.

Test get_unit_catalog_exposes_b2_schema_facing_metadata asserts decision_basis DEC-018, si_canonical basis, entered_units_preserved convention, unique accepted entries, and inch (25.4 mm/in) and Fahrenheit (459.67 offset) metadata.

Test render_calculation_report_command_renders_fixture_unblocked asserts an unblocked render with a 64-hex sha256, a DOCTYPE-led HTML body and a derived print view naming the hash, and that invalid input yields RENDER-INPUT-INVALID.

Test r2_from_blank_rehearsal_authors_solves_and_renders_report applies the A12 from-blank rehearsal steps, solves, and renders, asserting the report is not export-blocked, contains no script, and makes no code-compliant claim.
Test r2_from_blank_saved_project_opens_solves_and_renders_report saves the authored model to an in-memory store, reloads it, solves, renders, and asserts unit metadata is preserved.
Test local_project_store_uses_sqlite_fts5_and_round_trips_model_snapshot round-trips a full project envelope and asserts FTS5 indexing of editor, proposal, and selected-target text.
Test store_migration_ledger_reports_fresh_open_and_idempotent_reopen_evidence asserts a fresh store migrates v0 to v11 applying all eleven migrations, and a reopen applies none.
Test store_migration_ledger_reconciles_legacy_store_and_preserves_rows asserts a pre-ledger legacy store migrates v0 to v11 while preserving existing project rows.
Test store_migration_ledger_stages_v7_store_to_v8_applying_only_pending_migration asserts a v7-shape store applies only the v8 through v11 pending migrations.
Test local_project_store_lists_project_index_ordered_by_most_recent_update asserts the project index is ordered by most recent update and supports open-by-id and open-most-recent.

Test agent_proposal_preserves_selected_review_target_without_mutation_or_claims asserts the sample agent proposal targets the selected review reference, does not mutate accepted state, and makes no compliance/approval claim.
Test solve_job_seam_completes_and_reports_result_without_cancellation asserts a started job completes and publishes a result with cancellation_status not_requested.
Test run_preview_mechanics_uses_supplied_model_payload asserts an edited supplied model solves to MECHANICS_SOLVED.
Test run_preview_mechanics_reports_blank_model_incomplete_without_defaults asserts a blank model returns MODEL_INCOMPLETE with NODE/PIPE/LOAD_INPUT_MISSING diagnostics and no inserted defaults.
Test solve_job_seam_uses_supplied_model_payload asserts a background solve job uses the supplied model payload and completes.
Test solve_job_cancelled_before_execution_never_starts_the_solver asserts a cancel-before-start yields cancelled state cancelled_before_solver_start with no result.
Test solve_job_cancelled_mid_run_discards_result_at_publication_checkpoint asserts a mid-run cancellation discards the result at the cooperative publication checkpoint.
Test solve_job_cancellation_after_completion_is_rejected_without_success_claim asserts a cancel after completion is rejected without claiming cancellation success.
Test solve_job_cancellation_with_invalid_token_is_rejected_and_does_not_flag_the_job asserts a wrong cancellation token is rejected and an unknown job_id errors.
Test solve_job_with_invalid_model_payload_fails_with_recorded_error asserts an invalid model payload yields failed state with a recorded error message.

Test apply_model_operation_command_applies_inspector_intent_to_bundled_fixture_model asserts an inspector edit applies to a new document, leaves the input model untouched, records a non-professional acceptance basis, and still solves.

Test saved_edited_load_model_round_trips_and_solves_from_restored_payload asserts an edited 0.1.0-era model persists with a migration ledger record, round-trips, and re-solves to a different displacement.

Persisting a bundled 0.1.0-era model document walks the published DEC-033 no-op chain entry and appends a ledger record with applied migration id model-doc-0.1.0-to-0.2.0-additive-combination-shape-noop.
Test persist_preparation_refuses_newer_and_unsupported_model_documents asserts a 0.3.0 document is refused as newer_than_supported and an unversioned document as unsupported_schema.
Test persist_preparation_keeps_current_documents_without_ledger_records asserts a current-version document persists unchanged with status current and no ledger record.

Test saving_an_open_time_migrated_document_appends_a_ledger_record_with_pre_and_post_hashes asserts an open-time-migrated save records pre/post model hashes, source schema version, applied migration ids, destructive_rewrite false, and no compliance claim.
Test validate_model_operation_command_blocks_stale_intent_without_mutation asserts a stale before-value intent is blocked_stale with no mutation and an OP-STALE-BEFORE-VALUE diagnostic.
Test run_rule_checks_command_passing_demo_reports_user_rule_checked asserts a passing demo (actual 50 / limit 100 = 0.5) yields USER_RULE_CHECKED.
Test run_rule_checks_command_normalizes_compatible_rule_check_units asserts MPa/kPa inputs normalize to Pa before computing the rule ratio.
Test run_rule_checks_command_failing_case_reports_user_rule_failed asserts an over-limit actual (150) yields USER_RULE_FAILED.
Test run_rule_checks_command_missing_input_reports_rule_inputs_incomplete asserts an unsupplied solver_result input yields RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with a null computed value.
Test run_rule_checks_command_rejects_blocking_invalid_pack asserts an invalid rule pack yields RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
Test run_rule_checks_command_emits_only_status_vocabulary asserts the output never contains HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT, Certified, Sealed, or code_compliant.
Test local_rule_pack_store_round_trips_documents_per_project asserts rule packs round-trip per project, list with metadata, preserve created_at on update, and delete idempotently.
Test resolve_authored_solver_result_bindings_resolves_ref_and_records_input_id asserts an authored solver_result_ref resolves to a binding and records its input id.
Test resolve_authored_solver_result_bindings_records_input_id_but_omits_unresolvable_binding asserts an authored ref to a missing row records the input id but yields no binding so the input blocks.
Test extract_library_slot_value_reads_material_allowable asserts a material allowable resolves to (value, unit) and that unknown record/slot or a kind/document mismatch returns None.
Test extract_library_slot_value_reads_section_dimension_and_property asserts section dimension and property slots resolve with their plain unit strings.
Test extract_library_slot_value_reads_component_field asserts a component field slot resolves and unknown record/slot returns None.
Test extract_library_slot_value_returns_none_for_unknown_kind asserts an unknown or empty library_kind returns None.
Test library_value_ref_resolves_from_local_store asserts a material library_value_ref resolves from the local store to a binding.
Test library_value_ref_resolves_section_from_local_store asserts the kind-generic resolve path resolves a section property slot from the store.
Test library_value_ref_without_stored_library_resolves_to_no_binding asserts a reference with no stored library resolves to no binding so the input blocks.
Test run_rule_checks_core_threads_library_binding_to_user_rule_checked asserts a resolved private-library binding (limit 100) threads through to USER_RULE_CHECKED with a 'private library' note.
